scope: Row-decoded mapped GGUF storage for the historical native and RPN causal engines
behavior: CLI and server use open_mapped, retain only normalization vectors in the decoded pool and decode one matrix row at a time. open retains expanded storage for comparison. Input/output dimensions and causal execution are shared.
tests: Independent Q4 and pinned GGML Q6 head answers; native/expanded and native/mapped equality; RPN/expanded and RPN/mapped GQA closed-form prefix and incremental equality; byte output/EOS/context CLI tests; checked row indices and flattened outer axes.
limitations: Mapped files must remain immutable while borrowed.
get_embedding now returns Result; mapped matrix weights have no decoded pool offset.
Scratch scales with one decoded row plus output vector and existing KV, not the whole decoded model.
No complete symbolic transformer translation or .bmlgraph text generation is established.
post_gate_changes: Documentation-only clarification of expanded versus mapped pools and embedding errors.
